title: corethrogyne filaginifolia var. incana
intro: Corethrogyne filaginifolia var. incana, commonly known as Incensebrush, is a shrubby plant species native to the western United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Incensebrush include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it useful in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Corethrogyne filaginifolia var. incana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
